definitions.explanation: Indicates that a product contains no added fragrance or perfume. Composed of 無 (without) + 香料 (fragrance/perfume). Common on product labels for cosmetics, detergents, and personal care items.

examples.japanese: {無香料|むこうりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石鹸|せっけん}→石鹸：04981_sekken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{無香料|むこうりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んでいる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Since I have sensitive skin, I choose fragrance-free cosmetics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無香料|むこうりょう}・⟦{無着色|むちゃくしょく}→無着色：29231_muchakushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧だ。
examples.english: For baby detergent, fragrance-free and dye-free products are safest.

notes:
USAGE:
{無香料|むこうりょう} is used as a no-adjective to modify nouns: {無香料|むこうりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (fragrance-free product). It appears frequently on product labels and in advertising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無香料|むこうりょう}・⟦{無着色|むちゃくしょく}→無着色：29231_muchakushoku⟧ (fragrance-free and dye-free)
- {無香料|むこうりょう}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧ (unscented type)
- {無香料|むこうりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧ (fragrance-free detergent)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{香料|こうりょう}→香料：14678_kouryou⟧ (fragrance, perfume ingredient)
- ⟦{無添加|むてんか}→無添加：19283_mutenka⟧ (additive-free)
- {低刺激|ていしげき} (hypoallergenic, low-irritation)
